text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1; partially superseded diagnosis, unresolved scientific metadata contract. Current ScalaFIM delegates to image4s NiftiWriteOptions, which exposes nonSpatialPixelDimensions and temporalUnit; NiftiHeader.native exposes temporalUnit. NiftiIncrementalOutputSuite already checks a 0.75-second step and unit byte in physical output (source inspected, not rerun here). The pinned image4s NiftiModel.scala public header and write options do not expose temporal origin/toffset. ScalaFIM defaultSeriesWriteOptions still declares step 1 second, while defaultSeriesReadOptions assumes seconds for unknown units. Remaining acceptance: implement origin support in the authoritative provider and adopt a qualified pin; qualify public read/write nonzero origin, seconds/milliseconds, validation and independent bytes; define how series-axis metadata and explicit options agree or conflict so defaults cannot silently misstate known sampling. Preserve generic non-time axes and explicit unknown-unit policy; do not confuse stored acquisition timestamps with effective first-level sampling reference. No duplicate ScalaFIM header/parser or new fMRI-only assumptions.
